title: Hal Povenmire's visits from 2008 and his belief before he died in 2019 that the phenomenon was angelic

tellings.quote: But he said when I I know now to me it's um he believed it was angelic.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man from Fayetteville, North Carolina, who says he has had many UFO encounters, tells of visits from a man named Hal Povenmire starting in 2008. Bledsoe says that before Povenmire died in 2019, he had come to believe the phenomenon Bledsoe was experiencing was angelic. If true, it would cast these encounters as spiritual rather than as visits from space.
